card.name: Inside drug names, near the ending
card.fires_on: Responds to a piece partway through or at the end of a long drug name, often one ending in -ine or -idine. Seen for names such as glucagon, phenazopyridine, pentoxifylline, quinidine and sulfapyridine.

modes.label: Final -ine piece
modes.description: The closing 'ine' piece of a drug name like phenazopyridine or pentoxifylline.
